target_pattern: Use que tal plus noun for how is or was check-ins and que tal si plus present tense for natural how about suggestions.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Building full questions with extra verbs for every how is or how was sentence.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish often uses compact frames: que tal plus noun for check-ins and que tal si plus present for suggestions.
target_pattern_formula: que tal plus possessive plus noun
que tal si plus present nosotros
short response chunks such as bien, muy bien, regular, fatal
natural_examples: Que tal si vamos en taxi?

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using que tal or que tal si.
prompts_en: How about we go to the beach?
How about we stay home today?
How about we watch a movie?
How about we invite your friend?
How about we take a taxi?
How about we go to the store?
How about we cancel the reservation?

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Que tal la comida? -> change noun to la reunion.
Base: Que tal tu dia? -> change possessive to tu semana.
Base: Que tal el concierto? -> change noun to plural los conciertos.
Base: Que tal la clase? -> change noun to el curso.
Base: Que tal si vamos a la playa? -> change destination to el centro.
Base: Que tal si nos quedamos en casa? -> change to salimos a cenar.
Base: Que tal si practicamos espanol? -> change activity to revisamos el informe.
Base: Que tal si tomamos un taxi? -> change transport to el metro.
Base: Que tal si cocinamos algo? -> make it negative suggestion.
Base: Que tal si invitamos a Ana? -> change person to plural a tus amigos.
Base: Que tal la sopa? -> change noun to el cafe.
Base: Que tal si cancelamos la reservacion? -> change verb to confirmamos.
Base: Que tal el hotel? -> change to past-context noun el viaje.
Base: Que tal si vemos una pelicula? -> change object to una serie.
Base: Que tal la cena? -> turn into suggestion with same noun.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the more natural option for this lesson pattern.
prompts: How is the food? (Que tal la comida? vs Como es la comida?)
How was your day? (Que tal tu dia? vs Como fue tu dia?)
How about we go now? (Que tal si vamos ahora? vs Como si vamos ahora?)
How about we stay home? (Que tal si nos quedamos en casa? vs Que tal nos quedamos en casa?)
How is the coffee? (Que tal el cafe? vs Que tal es el cafe?)
How was the concert? (Que tal el concierto? vs Como estuvo el concierto?)
How about we invite Luis? (Que tal si invitamos a Luis? vs Que tal invitamos a Luis?)
How is your week? (Que tal tu semana? vs Como es tu semana?)
How about we cook? (Que tal si cocinamos? vs Como tal si cocinamos?)
How about we take a taxi? (Que tal si tomamos un taxi? vs Que tal tomamos un taxi?)

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish, not literal English.
prompts_en: How about we order food instead?
How about we talk after the meeting?
How about we keep it simple?
How about we try again tomorrow?

common_errors.why_it_happens: Adding an unnecessary verb in the fixed frame.

common_errors.mistake: Using subjunctive in every que tal si suggestion
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use que tal si plus present tense naturally.

common_errors.mistake: Que tal vamos a la playa?
common_errors.why_it_happens: Forgetting si in the suggestion pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Que tal si vamos a la playa?

common_errors.mistake: Forcing explicit tense words in every check-in
common_errors.correct_spanish: Que tal plus noun can be present or past by context.

common_errors.mistake: Que tal si ir a la tienda?
common_errors.why_it_happens: Using infinitive after si in this pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Que tal si vamos a la tienda?

common_errors.mistake: Writing suggestion lines without question marks
common_errors.why_it_happens: Treating it as a plain statement.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Write it as a question: Que tal si...?

common_errors.mistake: Avoiding short responses like bien or fatal
common_errors.why_it_happens: Belief that full sentences are mandatory.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Short chunks are natural and common.
